ownership: United States federal government public aggregate data
prohibited_use: attempting to identify an individual business from protected aggregates
representing annual aggregate counts as a current named-business directory
allocating national, state, or county totals to ZIP codes without a published source relationship
converting suppressed, flagged, or unpublished values into unsupported values
attribution: Source: U.S. Census Bureau Nonemployer Statistics.
retention: Indefinite for public aggregate source releases and derived artifacts unless an approved retention rule applies.
redistribution: Allowed with publisher, reference year, source universe, disclosure limitations, transformation version, and provenance.
